title: Origami Airforce Paper Airplane | Easy Tutorial!
description:
Learn how to make a fun, easy paper plane that flies far with this step-by-step origami tutorial! Perfect for anyone who loves creative paper crafts.

Materials needed:
- One sheet of paper

For this origami you only need one sheet of paper. I have an A4 sheet of printer paper, but other types of paper will work as well. Follow these tips to make the AIRFORCE paper airplane!
- Fold sharp creases and make the plane symmetrical
- To make the airplane fly upwards, slightly curve the back of the wings upwards
- Watch the video in high quality (HD or 4K)
- Rewind or adjust the video speed in the settings if needed
- HIT THE LIKE BUTTON FOR GOOD LUCK MAKING THE AIRPLANE!
